No Podman, a política de reinício só mu: On Podman, the restart policy only changes without recreating from version 5.1 on, and Podman 4 may keep showing the old limits (the new ones apply anyway).
No containerd (nerdctl), os valores atu: On containerd (nerdctl), the current values don't show here: fill in only what you want to change.
É um container de projeto: ao recriar (: It's a project container: when recreated (Up after changing the compose), the compose limits apply; to keep these, adjust the compose too.
The image will be deleted from this host.
A pasta e tudo dentro dela são apagados: The folder and everything in it are deleted from the container.
A senha sai do chaveiro. Logins já grava: The password is removed from the keychain. Logins already saved on the machines stay there.
Acesso total ao host: evite fora de test: Full access to the host: avoid outside of tests.
Acima disso o container é encerrado por: Above this the container is killed for running out of memory. E.g. 512m, 2g.
As senhas ficam em: {store}. O Gantry us: Passwords are stored in: {store}. Gantry uses the login when pulling and pushing images; "Log in on" also saves it to the machine's command line.
CPU, memória e reinício, sem recriar: CPU, memory and restart, without recreating
Caminho dentro do repositório (ou da sub: Path inside the repository (or the subfolder).
Carregar um .tar feito com docker save: Load a .tar made with docker save
Construindo {tag}… acompanhe no painel d: Building {tag}… follow it in the bottom panel
Criar um container com esta imagem: Create a container with this image
Depois do # vêm o branch e, após :, a su: After the # comes the branch and, after :, the subfolder. The engine downloads the repository; private repositories need access on the host.
Este container é do projeto \"{project}\: This container belongs to the project "{project}". When the project comes up again, compose may replace it with what is in the file; for permanent changes, edit the project's File tab.
Este host usa {rt}: o Gantry ainda não c: This host uses {rt}: Gantry can't build images on it yet. Use the engine's own build on the server.
Grava o estado atual do container (arqui: Saves the container's current state (files outside volumes) to a new image. The container is paused for a moment.
Grava o login no docker/podman de {host}: Saves the login in docker/podman on {host} (for compose and the terminal there)
Gravar o estado atual numa imagem: Save the current state to an image
An empty IP publishes on all interfaces. An empty host port: the engine picks a free one.
Imagem a carregar (.tar do docker save): Image to load (.tar from docker save)
Informe a porta do container em todas as: Enter the container port in every port row.
Enter the destination of every volume.
Limite brando, usado quando a máquina es: Soft limit, used when the machine is under pressure.
Limite flexível, aplicado quando falta m: Soft limit, applied when memory runs low.
More than one name: separate with commas (e.g. my-app:1.0, my-app:latest).
Muda na hora, sem recriar o container. C: Changes right away, without recreating the container. Empty fields stay as they are.
Navegar usa o shell do container (precis: Browsing uses the container's shell (it must be running). Download and upload work while it's stopped too. Changes outside volumes are lost when the container is recreated.
Nenhum registry cadastrado. Imagens públ: No registries added. Public images don't need one.
The file is deleted from the container.
O container está rodando e será parado a: The container is running and will be stopped first. Named volumes are kept.
O engine guarda os eventos por um tempo: The engine keeps events for a limited time (and loses them on restart). Shell commands and health checks don't show up.
O nome diz para onde vai: ghcr.io/usuari: The name says where it goes: ghcr.io/user/app:1.0, registry.example.com:5000/app:1.0 or user/app:1.0 (Docker Hub). The login comes from Registries (in the keychain).
Os containers que usam esta imagem preci: The containers using this image must be removed first.
Os dados do volume são apagados para sem: The volume's data is deleted for good.
Para ghcr.io, use um token com permissão: For ghcr.io, use a token with packages permission instead of the password.
Para imagens como alpine ou ubuntu ficar: To keep images like alpine or ubuntu running without a command, use interactive and TTY.
Parte da sub-rede de onde saem os IPs au: Part of the subnet automatic IPs come from; the rest is left for static IPs.
Publicar todas as portas expostas pela i: Publish all ports exposed by the image on random ports (-P)
Quantos núcleos ele pode usar no máximo: How many cores it can use at most (0.5 = half a core).
Remove as redes criadas que nenhum conta: Removes the created networks no container uses.
Remove todas as imagens que nenhum conta: Removes all images no container uses (not just untagged ones).
Remove todos os volumes que nenhum conta: Removes all volumes no container uses. Their data is deleted.
Salvar recria o container: ele é parado: Saving recreates the container: it is stopped and replaced by a new one with these options. Anything outside volumes is lost. If something goes wrong, the current container is kept (or recreated as it was).
Sem outros arquivos: COPY e ADD só funci: No other files: COPY and ADD only work with the Folder or Git source.
Without a registry, it comes from Docker Hub (docker.io).
Without a registry, it comes from Docker Hub.
Sempre baixar a imagem antes (pega a ver: Always pull the image first (gets the newest version of the tag)
Só em redes criadas por você, com sub-re: Only on networks you created, with a defined subnet.
Só esta tag é removida; a imagem continu: Only this tag is removed; the image keeps the others.
Só para \"quando falhar\"; 0 é sem limit: Only for "on failure"; 0 means no limit.
Um nome cria (ou usa) um volume; um cami: A name creates (or uses) a volume; a path starting with / mounts the host folder. Empty source: anonymous volume.
Uma por linha, como chave=valor. Ex.: um: One per line, as key=value. E.g. an NFS volume or a host folder (type=none, o=bind, device=/path).
Usa a rede {mode}; não dá para conectar: Uses the {mode} network; it can't connect to others.
Empty: the engine picks a name.
docker.io para o Docker Hub; registry.ex: docker.io for Docker Hub; registry.example.com:5000 for your own.
host e none compartilham ou desligam a r: host and none share or turn off the network.
label: label
macvlan e ipvlan precisam de parent=<int: macvlan and ipvlan need parent=<host interface>.
É enviada como contexto do build. O .doc: Sent as the build context. The folder's .dockerignore is respected.
